notes.title: Patchnotes: TWS Demo Build v.2.0.0-0005
notes.notes:
⚙️ We fixed and added the following things:

🐞 BUGS

- Fixed elevator not resetting when changing scenes
- Fixed spamming broken elevator to break your attack
- Disabled menu in cutscenes
- Dialogue UI will not appear infront of pause menu
- Fixed bones sometimes being paused after trying to close lore stones
- Fixed some parts of the menu buttons not being in english
- Fixed Dietrichs snail slime dialogue activating after changing scenes
- Increased pogo bounce hitbox
- Fixed lever animation not playing
- Fixed destructable walls respawning
- Fixed Wanderer not opening the door
- Fixed being able to start the dialogue with rabble at the same time as picking up the lantern

🌟 ADDED FEATURES
 - Added more instruction texts in sewer system

We thank everyone for finding and reporting all these bugs and hope that you are having fun with our demo!

notes.title: Patchnotes: TWS Demo Build v.2.0.0-0004
notes.notes:
⚙️ We fixed and added the following things:

🐞 [b]BUGS[/b]

- Added missing sounds in [i]Sewer System[/i]
- Player can't get stuck in first Hook-Rat room (hopefully 🙏)
- Can't [i]Respawn to Checkpoint[/i] without activating a checkpoint 
- Fixed scenes loading twice when respawning to checkpoint via [i]Pause-Menu[/i]
- Fixed issues with Wanderer not spawning the rune next to him
- Fixed one part in [i]Snailcave[/i] where camera was not panning down
- Fixed trinkets not being selected in [i]Trinket-Menu[/i]
- Fixed Button descriptions in [i]Controls-Menu[/i]
- Disabled [i]Secret Light[/i] in Dialogue
- Player [i]Respawn to Checkpoint[/i] in story relevant areas

🌟 [b]ADDED FEATURES[/b]

- Added Mouse Cursor
- The Secret Light will brighten more of the environment
- Added new sounds to Gisela boss
- Added more SFX

notes.title: Welcome to our Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to our demo at Steam Next Fest! 🎉

A huge thank you to all the players who are taking the time to try out our game. Your support means a lot to us! We work closely with the community during development because your feedback is invaluable to us. Every comment, every suggestion and every critical feedback helps us to improve the game experience.

We cordially invite you to become part of our Discord community. There you can communicate directly with the development team, ask questions and connect with other players. Your enthusiasm and ideas are the fuel that drives our game forward.

Thank you for being part of this exciting journey! We hope all players have a lot of fun exploring the demo. Your support makes all the difference and we look forward to shaping the world of our game together with you. 🚀

notes.title: Play with the devs of The Wicked Souls
notes.notes:
Join us as the developers of "The Wicked Souls" dive deep into the game's secrets in an exclusive livestream on February 10th, 2024, at 10 AM PT (7 PM German time)! Watch us navigate through the mystical world, overcome challenges, and maybe even reveal some hidden Easter eggs. This is your chance to interact with us directly, ask burning questions, and gain insights into the game's development. Save the date, get your questions ready, and become part of our unique gaming community. Don't miss this rare opportunity to peek behind the curtain of our enthralling Metroidvania adventure!

We will keep the stream in English. Unfortunately, we are not native English speakers, but we will do our best to make sure you understand us! We will be happy to answer quick questions in German, or you can follow us on [url=https://discord.gg/KGYTrXZbJd]our Discord-Channel[/url] to talk to us directly.
